description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Findbroker, adding {B}.
When Golgari Findbroker dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Golgari Findbroker.
Repeat.
